WH.markup.printHtml( WH.Gatherer.addData(91, 1, {"1288658":{"id":1288658,"imageType":2,"width":4264,"height":1616,"staffOnly":0}}); WH.markup.printHtml("[db=live]\r\nGear represents one of the most important avenues towards strengthening your Frost Mage by providing the majority of your stats, armor, and other gameplay elements such as procs and set bonuses.\r\n\r\nThis guide explains how to obtain the best gear for your Frost Mage in [b]Midnight Season 2[\/b] and how to determine whether an item is Best-in-Slot, an upgrade, or outright bad. It will help you identify the best pieces of gear from dungeons and raids in Midnight, whether they be weapons, trinkets, or armor.\r\n[center][wrapper width=80%]\r\n[nav]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/overview-pve-dps]Overview[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/bis-gear]BiS Gear[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps]Rotation[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/talent-builds-pve-dps]Talent Builds[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/enchants-gems-pve-dps]Consumables[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/stat-priority-pve-dps]Stats[\/nav-item]\r\n[nav-item=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/basics icon=Inv_misc_groupneedmore]Basics[\/nav-item]\r\n[\/nav][\/wrapper][\/center]\r\nFor other Mage specs, you can check our [url=guide\/classes\/mage\/arcane\/bis-gear]Arcane Mage BiS[\/url] and [url=guide\/classes\/mage\/fire\/bis-gear]Fire Mage BiS[\/url] pages for the best.\r\n[toc]\r\n\r\n[h2 type=bar toc=\"Recommended Gear\"][icon name=inv_misc_orb_blue color=c8 inline=true size=medium type=round][\/icon] Recommended Gear for Frost Mage in Midnight Season 2[\/h2]\r\nGearing and itemization are one of the most important aspects towards improving your character. Gear mainly comes from [url guide=33180]Raids[\/url] on a weekly lockout, [url guide=33272]Mythic+ Dungeons[\/url], or the [url guide=17592]Vault System[\/url].\r\n[h3 toc=\"BiS Gear\"]What is the BiS Frost Mage gear?[\/h3]\r\nWhile raid drops are generally the most reliable way to obtain high item level gear, items from other sources can be just as good, if not better. As such, you should reference the [url=guide\/classes\/mage\/frost\/stat-priority-pve-dps]stat priorities for Frost Mage[\/url] to help determine your own upgrade path based on what is available to you. [html] Archon<\/a>[\/html] is a tool that can help determine which alternative gear options are available in any given slot, especially if you're unable to obtain a best-in-slot piece.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nIn general, you will want to look for items following the Frost Mage stat priority of [b]Mastery >= Critical Strike > Haste >= Versatility[\/b]. However, that doesn't mean you don't want any Haste or Versatility; you will still need a balance of all four stats to do optimal damage.\r\n\r\n[tabs uniform=true name=bis_items]\r\n [tab name=\"Overall BiS\" icon=8039569]\r\n [h3 toc=false][color=c8]Best in Slot Gear for Frost Mage [\/color][\/h3]\r\n\r\n The main items you will need are 4 tier pieces, strong trinkets, and ideally the special cantrip items from the raid. In Season 2, catalyzed items will retain their stats, allowing players to target specific pieces of gear to catalyze.
